dataset.note: India national helplines for learner reference. Prefer 112 when unsure.

numbers.name: Unified emergency
numbers.when_to_call: Any serious emergency — police, fire, or ambulance. Use when you are not sure which single service to call.

numbers.name: Police
numbers.when_to_call: Crime, theft, assault, hit-and-run, or when you need police at the scene.

numbers.name: Fire
numbers.when_to_call: Fire, smoke, fuel leak, or vehicle burning after a crash.

numbers.name: Ambulance
numbers.when_to_call: Medical emergency — injury, unconscious person, breathing trouble.

numbers.name: Ambulance (108)
numbers.when_to_call: Medical emergency in many States — especially road crashes with injuries.

numbers.name: Highway helpline
numbers.when_to_call: Breakdown or incident on a national highway — towing, lane blockage, NHAI assistance.

numbers.name: Women helpline
numbers.when_to_call: Harassment or safety threat involving women — also try 112 for immediate danger.
